readout_other: 32-channel skull EEG; 64-channel intracranial array evoked potentials; seizure count and duration; PSD, asymmetry index, phase lag index
direction_notes: Corpus callosum tFUS reduced percent time in seizure, seizure count and duration and increased inter-seizure interval versus sham, with effects persisting up to 2 hours after stimulation.

device.model: H276 128-element random array transducer; Verasonics Vantage 128

timing.protocol_description: 20 ms pulses at 1 Hz (2% duty cycle) delivered continuously for ~62.5 minutes (3,750 pulses) to the corpus callosum during the condition block, followed by about 3 hours of post-stimulation recording.

source_quotes.n_subjects: An additional 7 rats (23 total) were included in a mechanism study.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: tFUS was applied using a 128-element random array transducer (H276, $f _ { 0 } = 1 . 5$ MHz) and corresponding Verasonics Vantage 128 ultrasound system [35].
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The pulse duration (PD), pulse repetition frequency (PRF = 1/PRP, pulse repetition period), duty cycle (DC), and in situ pressure were set to 20 ms, 1 Hz, 2%, and ∼127 kPa, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The pulse duration (PD), pulse repetition frequency (PRF = 1/PRP, pulse repetition period), duty cycle (DC), and in situ pressure were set to 20 ms, 1 Hz, 2%, and ∼127 kPa, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: The pulse duration (PD), pulse repetition frequency (PRF = 1/PRP, pulse repetition period), duty cycle (DC), and in situ pressure were set to 20 ms, 1 Hz, 2%, and ∼127 kPa, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: The pulse duration (PD), pulse repetition frequency (PRF = 1/PRP, pulse repetition period), duty cycle (DC), and in situ pressure were set to 20 ms, 1 Hz, 2%, and ∼127 kPa, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: A total of 3,750 pulses of stimulation (∼62.5 minutes) were applied to the CC in the experimental group.
